properties.name: East-West Transit Study
properties.status: Early study (alignment + mode screening) — no route or mode chosen yet
properties.mode: Mode not yet determined (KCATA + KC Streetcar Authority are evaluating streetcar, BRT, and other options)
properties.source: ridekc.org/planning/eastwesttransit — study area bounded by Rainbow Blvd (west), Van Brunt Blvd (east), 31st St (north), 43rd St (south); Nov 2023 materials show the corridor alignment along 39th Street and Linwood Boulevard.
properties.cost_method: Rough order-of-magnitude only: illustrative route length x $87-100M/mile, KCs own two most recent streetcar extension costs (Riverfront ~$87M/mi, Main Street ~$100M/mi) -- not an official project cost estimate, which none of these studies has published yet.

properties.name: North Kansas City Extension
properties.status: Early study — comparing track configurations, station locations, and turnback points
properties.source: kcstreetcar.org — study area from River Market across the Missouri River to ~32nd Ave in North Kansas City, bounded west by the ASB Railroad Bridge/BNSF right-of-way, east by Charlotte and Swift Streets.
properties.cost_method: Rough order-of-magnitude only: illustrative route length x $87-100M/mile, KCs own two most recent streetcar extension costs (Riverfront ~$87M/mi, Main Street ~$100M/mi) -- not an official project cost estimate, which none of these studies has published yet. Likely an UNDER-estimate here specifically: a Missouri River crossing means bridge and utility work well beyond what a flat street extension costs, and neither KC benchmark involved a river crossing.

properties.name: North Kansas City Extension — illustrative alignment
18th & Vine Jazz District Extension
properties.status: Feasibility study — comparing route options (public open house held July 2026)
properties.population_method: No formal study-area boundary has been published for this one (unlike the other two) — population is estimated within a 0.5-mile buffer of the illustrative route instead.
properties.source: kcstreetcar.org / KCTV5 coverage — proposed extension east from the existing line into the 18th & Vine corridor; specific streets not published, route shown here follows 18th Street to Vine Street as the most direct plausible path.
properties.cost_method: Rough order-of-magnitude only: illustrative route length x $87-100M/mile, KCs own two most recent streetcar extension costs (Riverfront ~$87M/mi, Main Street ~$100M/mi) -- not an official project cost estimate, which none of these studies has published yet.
